subject: C13
required_fixes: R1 (remaining) — Validate nested rated-target counts before inferring quiet statistics. crates/desktop-core/src/red_team.rs:298 reduces risk_profile[].targets_by_type to a positive-count predicate, silently ignoring invalid counts and malformed containers. For example, {"risk_profile":[{"risk_rating":"LOW","total":0,"targets_by_type":[{"name":"MODEL","count":-1}]}]} reaches statistics():315 as quiet and produces successful scans=0, targets=0. A non-array targets_by_type or 65 nested target entries is also accepted. The pinned v1 observations parser rejects all three; D039 and prior R1 require a validated entirely quiet source before missing totals become zero. Acceptance: validate each reported nested group, entry and count, including its bounds, before deciding quietness; negative/fractional/missing counts, malformed groups and oversized nested arrays must produce invalid statistics rather than zero tiles. Add raw production-interface fixtures proving independent scan/model/skill sources remain usable, and preserve valid all-zero nested groups.

R4 — Malformed pagination metadata can still establish completeness and false absence. crates/desktop-core/src/red_team.rs:372 obtains total_items with chained get calls without validating the pagination container; {"data":[],"pagination":"invalid"} is treated as an ordinary short page with no total and marked complete. The same page is accepted by proves_no_scans():405, so management.rs:1680 can turn a statistics 404 plus malformed confirmation into successful no_scans=true. The count_capped branch also treats an explicitly null flag as false, although the v1 contract rejects a present non-boolean flag. This bypasses the intended distinction between invalid, unknown and confirmed empty sources across scan and attack pages. Acceptance: reject malformed pagination containers and present non-boolean count_capped values before computing coverage; these replies must never prove no scans or all attacks read. Add raw fixtures for the 404-confirmation path and ordinary list/attack reads. Preserve valid pagination objects with an omitted total, complete-empty results and normal 100/100/50 coverage.
limitations: Read-only review: no application files were changed, no application/endpoints were launched, and no credentials were accessed. Rust producer behavior for the counterexamples was traced in source rather than newly executed; the required negative Rust fixtures remain to be added.

They reject negative, malformed and oversized nested target groups, malformed pagination and a null count_capped flag; valid empty-page and quiet-skill baselines pass. Both reference files match commit 74754c02. These probes establish the reference behavior, not execution of the Rust implementation.

R1's top-level failure-envelope, missing-total and breakdown-limit cases are improved; nested validation remains as described above.

Every attack timing repetition records ten pages and every Model/skill repetition records three source reads.
